newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Industria optimistic on outlook.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Industria optimistic on outlook.

text.p: Portugal's Sonae Industria, the wood, real estate and media group, is optimistic about the outlook for 1997 due to growth in South Africa and Zimbabwe.

"1997 will be marked by advances in the process of globalisation stemming from the growth of commercial activity in South Africa and the start of industrial operations in Zimbabwe," according to the Sonae group annual report.
It also pointed to signs of stability in the wood market.
These factors led the company to view the current year "with prudent optimism," it said.
Even if the condition of over-production remained in wood products, particularly in the MDF sector, there were signs that a balance could be restored within the next few years, it said.
